result: Implemented a source-hash-bound streaming sAlex adapter for the official tar.gz of ASE-LMDB shards. The compressed archive is not persisted; one .aselmdb shard is materialized at a time, iterated with ASE>=3.29, and deleted before the next shard. Complete source size/MD5/SHA256 and record count are checked fail-closed. Membership build failures now remove SQLite WAL/SHM sidecars. Production sAlex index remains unauthorized until the frozen structure-fingerprint and prototype-group executors are implemented.
